# Swift House Sold

> Swift House Sold is a cash home buying company serving Ohio, Texas and Georgia. We make written cash offers on houses within 24 hours and can close in as little as 7-14 days. Sellers pay no agent fees, no closing costs and make no repairs. We also run a buyer network that gives real estate investors first access to off-market deals in the same three states.

Key facts:
- Service areas: Ohio, Texas, Georgia (USA)
- Offer timeline: written cash offer within 24 hours of property details
- Closing timeline: 7-14 days typical, seller picks the date
- Seller costs: none (no commissions, no closing costs, no repairs)
- Every closing runs through a licensed, insured escrow or title company
- Contact: https://swift-house-sold.com/contact/
